connector.name: GenMB
connector.registryDescription: List, read, edit, and deploy your GenMB AI-generated apps from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at genmb.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.genmb, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-MCP-API-Key
headers.description: Optional GenMB API key (genmb_sk_..., Pro plan) for scripts/CI. Interactive clients can omit it - the server supports OAuth browser sign-in.
